targetText: The part played by church and state in this sort of "sacred marriage" is not a worthy one.
summary: Documenting rising divorce rates, domestic violence, and marital misery across Europe and the United States, Bebel shows that capitalist economic pressures and patriarchal legal codes systematically disrupt and dissolve the traditional family across all social classes.
